scenarios.name: Duplicate an appearance from the editor

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open

scenario_steps.name: an applied ceramic appearance is open in the Appearance Editor
its type is Ceramic, its finish is Matte, and Wavy Finish Bumps are enabled
I choose Duplicate from the editor creation menu
the editor switches to a new appearance with a distinct name
the new appearance retains the visible type, finish and bump settings
